assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001..003 are repository-maintained provisional rough polygons, not official redlines.
assumptions.formula: all dependent areas are projected to EPSG:4548 and recomputed from these temporary polygons
assumptions.uncertainty: boundary location and precision; every derived area and ratio may change
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: official or rights-cleared site/key-area GIS or CAD polygons become available
assumptions.impact: Suitable for concept comparison and spatial QA only; unsuitable for approval, land title, compensation or precise official area claims.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, parcels/ownership, existing buildings, roads/rail, heritage, water, utilities, fire, geotechnical and hazard geometry are unavailable.
assumptions.formula: not applicable; unavailable controls remain explicit unknowns and are never spatially fabricated
assumptions.uncertainty: implementation feasibility, retain/renovate/demolish decisions, approved development capacity and engineering interfaces
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: any corresponding official or cleared dataset is supplied
assumptions.impact: The spatial model is a non-statutory design proposal and must be recalibrated by licensed professional teams before implementation use.

assumptions.statement: The land-use layer is a topology-complete conceptual allocation derived from the provisional site, not an approved regulatory plan.
assumptions.basis: design narrative plus MNR classification terminology; no site-specific statutory land-use control is claimed
inputs: five programme bands split about the canonical straight spine
assumptions.formula: SITE - ROAD_AREA - GREEN_SPACE - PUBLIC_SPACE, then topology-safe orthogonal split into programme cells
assumptions.uncertainty: parcel, existing use, ownership, public-service demand and statutory code allocation
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: official parcels, current land-use survey or regulatory-plan controls become available
assumptions.impact: Every square metre is labelled for auditability, while codes remain design intentions rather than permissions.

assumptions.statement: Roads are low-curvature proposed centre-lines with assumed design widths and are not existing roads, surveyed rail alignments or road redlines.
assumptions.basis: one weighted straight fit to the provisional site/key-area centres, two constant 330 m offsets and six key-area/spacing-derived orthogonal links; OSM remains background only
assumptions.formula: ROAD_AREA = union(buffer(ROAD_CENTERLINE, design_width_m / 2)) clipped to SITE-001
assumptions.uncertainty: alignment, cross-section, intersection, parking, traffic capacity, fire access and property impacts
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: official road redlines, traffic survey, access/fire review or detailed cross-sections are supplied
assumptions.impact: Road length/area metrics are design-model quantities only.

assumptions.statement: The axis-linked green system, five aligned green rooms, paired plazas and twelve nodes are conceptual public-realm allocations with no fabricated surveyed watercourse; green polygons separate at road crossings.
assumptions.basis: canonical low-curvature public-interest spine, three key-area rooms, two portal rooms and six paired cross-link stations
assumptions.formula: green/public-space union areas are clipped to SITE-001 and made mutually exclusive with ROAD_AREA
assumptions.uncertainty: blue line, hydrology, flood/groundwater, utilities, accessibility gradients, ownership and detailed landscape design
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: surveyed water/terrain, blue line, drainage model, accessibility audit or public-space ownership becomes available
assumptions.impact: Green and public-space ratios are reproducible design-model ratios, not approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Building polygons are concept massing aligned to one orthogonal spine frame for the three provisional key areas, not surveyed existing buildings, parcel decisions or construction footprints.
assumptions.basis: distinct conceptual morphology for accelerator campus, shared community blocks and compact industry cluster without arbitrary angle rotation
assumptions.uncertainty: existing condition, retain/renovate/demolish status, buildability, height/FAR/density controls, fire/daylight/energy/structure and cost
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: cleared existing-building survey, official parcels and development controls become available
assumptions.impact: Only design-model counts, areas and ratios may be quoted; no existing-building or approved-capacity claim is valid.

assumptions.statement: The three non-overlapping phase polygons form a complete spatial sequence for discussion, not a committed delivery programme.
assumptions.basis: pilot the central origin community, extend south, then complete the northern accelerator network
assumptions.formula: three horizontal topology-safe partitions whose union equals SITE-001
assumptions.uncertainty: ownership, funding, approvals, dependencies, market, infrastructure, construction logistics and schedule
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: project list, ownership, cost, funding and delivery dependencies are professionally confirmed
assumptions.impact: Phase areas are auditable concept allocations only.

assumptions.statement: The 2026-08-12 Beijing government webpage confirms public approval status and textual planning context, but the approved plan document, maps and machine-readable controls have not been obtained.
assumptions.formula: no spatial or regulatory control is derived from the news text; existing provisional geometry remains separately labelled
assumptions.uncertainty: official boundary, parcel controls, road/rail/heritage interfaces, FAR, height, density, setback and implementation conditions
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: the approved control-plan document, rights-cleared maps or official GIS/CAD and control tables become available
assumptions.impact: The approval report may guide narrative alignment only; it cannot validate or replace any submitted geometry or design-model metric.

assumptions.statement: The 2026-08-21 OpenStreetMap / Overpass extract is used only as open-data background context and is not treated as a surveyed existing-condition base, legal redline, statutory plan, approval map or engineering input.
assumptions.formula: three grouped Overpass queries within the registered WGS84 bbox; clip to bbox; transform to EPSG:4548; simplify polygons at 0.9 m and other geometries at 0.6 m with topology preserved; make valid when required; return to EPSG:4326
assumptions.uncertainty: crowdsourced coverage, tagging, positional accuracy, completeness and snapshot currency; asset condition, legal status and survey precision are not established
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: a new attributed OSM snapshot is deliberately adopted, or official/rights-cleared existing-condition GIS, field survey or professional mapping becomes available
assumptions.impact: The extract may improve contextual legibility and help frame survey questions, but it cannot validate any submitted boundary, land-use allocation, road/rail alignment, key-area limit, existing-building count, metric or implementation conclusion.

assumptions.statement: All regional-coordination interfaces, activity brands, developer-community roles, international-communication routes, and pilot-conversion roles are conceptual suggestions; no named counterpart has confirmed participation and no government, institution, company, host, site, data, funding, compute, procurement, investment, or implementation commitment is claimed.
assumptions.basis: DATA-SRC-AGENT-TASKBOOK-20260518 requires regional synergy and long-term operations while prohibiting invented partnerships, resources, events, recruitment, funding, or government commitments.
assumptions.formula: not applicable; each proposed interface advances only through recorded authorisation, rights/data review, accountable roles, a non-AI baseline, a timebox, verification evidence, and an executable exit/restoration condition
assumptions.uncertainty: counterpart interest, mandate, lawful data/rights basis, responsible bodies, site access, dates, resources, funding, compute, delivery route, and approval status
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: a named counterpart supplies a public or rights-cleared written scope, authorised responsible roles, resource/site conditions, and a reviewable test protocol, or declines/withdraws participation
assumptions.impact: The matrices are auditable collaboration briefs and no-go gates, not evidence of an existing partnership, scheduled event, recruitment result, procurement, investment, approval, or implementation.
